items.hook: The Aspern Papers is a 2018 period drama, co-written, co-produced and directed by Julien Landais, based on Jean Pavans' scenic adaptation of Henry James' eponymous 1888 novel.
items.body: The film stars Jonathan Rhys-Meyers, Joely Richardson and Vanessa Redgrave; Academy Award-winner James Ivory acting as executive producer. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Doctor Dolittle and the Green Canary is a Doctor Dolittle book written by Hugh Lofting.
items.body: Although much of the material had been printed originally in 1924 for the Herald Tribune Syndicate, Lofting planned to complete the story in the book form but never finished before he died. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Hard Times: For These Times is the tenth novel by English author Charles Dickens, first published in 1854.
items.body: The book surveys English society and satirises its social and economic conditions. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Oppermanns is a 1933 novel by Lion Feuchtwanger.
items.body: It is the second novel in his Wartesaal trilogy, which tells about the rise of Nazism in Germany; the first part of the trilogy is Success (1930) and the last is Exil (1940). One of those things you can't un-know.
